headline: Deadlocked adds six PAL functions while larger matching batches await review
summary: Ratchet: Deadlocked merged C implementations for six PAL-only functions (#90), including work in DreadZone Station, Tempus Station and the Dark Cathedral. The tracked NTSC-U v1.00 progress stays at 7.17% of code, with 5,435 of 18,085 functions matched. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
highlights: Three unmerged proposals each cover 50 PAL functions: resident routines (#93), engine and menu routines (#95), and interface and loader routines (#99).
Other unmerged proposals cover 26 NTSC-U functions (#94) and 198 NTSC-U functions adapted from existing PAL matches (#97).
A 14-function PAL proposal includes build support for shared data and verification of a switch table (#96). It has not merged.
Draft #98 proposes 99 NTSC-U function matches and refreshed progress figures for both regions. Those proposed increases are not part of the merged branch.
